title: Start the stopped AWS WorkSpace already identified by the read-only diagnosis
description: Start the caller's own stopped Amazon WorkSpace after a read-only diagnosis has already proven assignment, a STOPPED state, and an on-demand running mode. The WorkspaceId, Region, DirectoryId and WorkSpaces username come only from the trusted server-side offer and private mapping; they are never supplied by the model or the caller. This is the only AWS mutation available and it never stops, reboots, rebuilds, restores, terminates, or modifies a WorkSpace.
effects: start the caller's own stopped Amazon WorkSpace exactly once through a confirmed, action-bound offer
verify the resulting WorkSpace state read-only until AWS reports AVAILABLE before reporting success
